## Giant Shrike (CR 6)

This fierce-looking bird’s ebon feathers gleam majestically, streaked with patterns of gray and brown. Its golden beak is tipped with white.  

**XP** 2,400  
N Large animal  
**Init** +5; **Senses** low-light vision; Perception +14  


**Defense**


**AC** 19, touch 15, flat-footed 13 (+5 Dex, +1 dodge, +4 natural, –1 size)  
**hp** 120 (10 HD; 10d8+30)  
**Fort** +10, **Ref** +12, **Will** +4  


**Offense**


**Speed** 10 ft., fly 70 ft. (average)  
**Melee** 2 talons +13 (1d6+5 plus grab), bite +12 (1d8+5)  
**Space** 10 ft.; **Reach** 10 ft.  
**Special Attacks** impale  


**Statistics**


**Str** 20, **Dex** 20, **Con** 16, **Int** 2, **Wis** 12, **Cha** 9  
**Base Atk** +7; **CMB** +13 (+21 grapple); **CMD** 28 (30 vs. grapple)  
**Feats** Flyby Attack, Greater Grapple, Improved Grapple, Weapon Focus (talon), Wingover  
**Skills** Acrobatics +8 Fly +16, Stealth +8  


**Special Abilities**



**Impale (Ex)** As a free action at the end of a movement while a giant shrike has a creature grappled and is adjacent to a jagged rock, tree, weathervane, or other similarly spiky protrusion, it can impale the grappled creature on it. The grappled creature takes 2d8+10 points of piercing damage (DC 20 Reflex half) and is no longer grappled; however, a creature failing its saving throw is entangled and unable to move. Each round at the beginning of its turn, an impaled creature takes an additional 1d8+5 points of piercing damage. It can end the entangled condition as a move action with a DC 16 Strength or Escape Artist check, taking an additional 1d8+5 points of piercing damage regardless of whether the check succeeds. If the shrike has impaled the creature on a high place, a creature that escapes impalement is considered to be climbing, with a DC determined by the nature of the place where they were impaled (GM’s discretion).  

**Vicious Snatcher (Ex)** A giant shrike that grapples a target while using its Flyby Attack feat does not gain the grappled condition and can move and carry along with it a Medium or smaller grappled creature without needing to make additional checks until the beginning of its next turn.  


**Ecology**


**Environment** cool areas with natural spikes, such as jagged mountain peaks or thorny forests  
**Organization** solitary, watch (2-6), or flock (12-24)  
**Treasure** none
